capabilities: group graph view notes into clusters by folder
fade links that stop pulling so every link stays on screen
detect each folder's main note and pull only links to it (Spokes)
pin folder main notes on a circle with the Ring setting
toggle folder clusters with a command
extras: The README warns the plugin reaches into graph view internals Obsidian doesn't officially expose, so updates may stop it working (disabling always restores the normal graph). Requires Obsidian 1.13 or newer, tested only on desktop, and releases carry GitHub attestations you can verify with the gh CLI.
intentEvidence: I looked for a setting to group the graph by folder and there isn't one.
motivation: The author's graph collapsed into one grey knot because notes link across folders, and no existing setting groups the graph by folder, so they built one that keeps Obsidian's own graph and colors.
problem: Obsidian's graph view has no way to group notes by folder, so cross-folder links drag everything into one tangled pile.
summary: Graph view tweak that groups notes into per-folder clusters by deciding which links pull the layout and fading the ones that let go.
